text:
The fault is in M1's gate connection. In the netlist, M1 is `M1 iin iout vss vss`, so its gate sits on `iout` instead of `iin`. That breaks the diode connection of the NMOS mirror. With the gate at the output node (0.9 V) and the drain at the input node, M1 is pushed into triode (Vds = 0.073 V < Vdsat = 0.307 V), which matches the operating-point table. The ~5 pA output and the large 100% current error follow from this. M1 also has the largest sensitivity for iout error. M2 and M4 are the next most likely suspects because they form the rest of the mirror path.

